== Biography ==

The Knave of Hearts is a figure of the royal court of Hearts. In the grand procession of the King and Queen, he bears the King's crown upon a crimson velvet cushion, processing amongst the royal party. When the Queen interrogates a visitor, she addresses the Knave directly; he responds with a bow and smile, though the Queen regards him with little patience, calling him an "Idiot" and commanding his actions. He obeys her orders with care—when she instructs him to "Turn them over," he does so "very carefully, with one foot."

The Knave later stands trial before the King and Queen for the theft of the royal tarts. He is brought before them in chains, guarded by soldiers on either side, and protests his innocence, asserting that he did not write the incriminating evidence and that no name has been signed to it.

== Relationships ==

'''[[King]]''' — employment. The Knave appears to serve the King, carrying his crown on a crimson velvet cushion during state processions.

'''[[Queen]]''' — enemy. The Queen appears to regard the Knave as an adversary, dismissing him as an "idiot" and later presiding over his trial.
